summary: Mobile Ask home and composer redesign (Workshop assistant/conversations v4-v6): prompt-row home with offline and set-up states, pill/card composer with photo thumbnails, recording waveform pill and a floating + menu (Camera, Upload photo, Upload file). File limits are now one app constant tied to the server's (4 per message, 60 per chat, photos 10 MB as picked, PDFs 2 MB and 20 pages). Attachment processing refuses a PDF over 20 pages (FILE_TOO_MANY_PAGES) instead of reading only the first 20. Assistant replies on mobile render as structured Markdown (paragraphs, headings, lists, tables as rows, tabular numbers; links stay plain text, no HTML) in an open, dashboard-like layout (Workshop A2d v2.2).
noAssistantImpact: No capability, tool, prompt, contract or write path changes. The client changes the Ask screen layout and which files it lets through; the server change only turns an over-limit PDF from a truncated read into a refusal with owner-facing copy. The model sees the same delimited extraction for every accepted file.

docs.note: Ask box file limits and PDF page refusal, 4 November 2026.
